prompt: What is the purpose of the @deprecated Javadoc tag (in addition to the @Deprecated annotation)?
choices: To delete the method from the compiled output
To explain WHY the element is deprecated and what to use instead
To prevent the method from being called at runtime
To generate a compile error when the method is used
explanation: @Deprecated annotation triggers compiler warnings. The @deprecated Javadoc tag (lowercase) provides the explanation: @deprecated Use {@link #newMethod()} instead. Both should be used together so tools and developers know about and understand the deprecation.
